verdict.rationale: Okta's first-party docs describe event hooks as outbound HTTPS REST calls from Okta to a URL you specify, sent when specified events occur in your org. That is a registrable outbound webhook a programmatic consumer can subscribe to and receive. The evidence is a concept-level description only. Missing for 10: documentation of how hooks are registered and managed (API or console), the list of subscribable event types, delivery guarantees such as retries and signing/verification, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
